evidence: The checkpoint top-level keys are callbacks, epoch, global_step, hparams_name, hyper_parameters, loops, lr_schedulers, optimizer_states, pytorch-lightning_version, and state_dict.

The checkpoint hyper_parameters keys are loss_weights, lr_scheduler_conf, network_conf, optimizer_conf, and provide_initial_pos. They contain no participant IDs, session IDs, dataset manifest, or split identity.
At official repository HEAD, config/base.yaml defaults to data_split: full_split; config/data_split/full_split.yaml points to metadata.csv; emg2pose/utils.py load_splits reads its split column.
The official repository worktree is dirty; the above source statements were checked at immutable Git HEAD. A repository default does not establish how this particular checkpoint was trained.
